# It's Not Rocket Science Classroom

> A comprehensive NGSS-aligned science curriculum platform offering Secondary Science Simplified® courses in Biology, Chemistry, Physical Science, and Anatomy & Physiology with professional development resources for teachers.

It's Not Rocket Science Classroom provides standards-aligned science curricula and teacher training designed to simplify secondary science education. The platform offers full-year courses, mini-courses, and professional development opportunities for science educators.

## Key Topics

- NGSS-aligned
- Secondary Science Simplified®
- Biology Curriculum
- Chemistry Curriculum
- Physical Science
- Anatomy & Physiology
- High School Science
- Teacher Resources
- Professional Development
- Standards-aligned
- Science Lesson Plans
- Course Catalog
- Teacher Training
- Science Education
